evals.prompt: Inspect the Preferences window of my macOS app while I keep working. Discovery shows two windows from the same app, titled Preferences and Main. Capture Preferences and tell me whether the Save button is visible.
evals.expected_output: Discover live windows, select the exact Preferences ID, capture from the intended workspace, immediately open the returned absolute PNG with the built-in image reader, then answer from actual pixels. Preserve focus and retain the capture.

evals.prompt: The window I asked you to inspect may be minimized or in another Space. Capture returned exit 8, capture_unavailable. Can you use yesterday's PNG or switch Spaces to see it?
evals.expected_output: Explain that unavailable does not prove minimization. Do not reuse an older image, switch Spaces, restore, or raise the window. Report no new visual inspection and ask for a manual state change if needed.

evals.prompt: Delete only the two Vishot captures you created for this task. Another agent is using the same workspace. Your recorded paths are /workspace/.vishot/window-42-1.png and /workspace/.vishot/window-42-2.png.
evals.expected_output: Remove only the two recorded exact paths with a file tool or quoted exact-path command. Leave every other capture and the .vishot directory intact. Report the removed files.
